requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

803-1486-4231-5291--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1742-1978-3363-7714.manaNeeded: {6} plus either {1} or an additional card in hand
1742-1978-3363-7714.description:
Cast The One Ring by paying {4}.
When The One Ring enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of it that is a 2/2 Robot Villain.
Put the noncreature One Ring into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Move to your next turn.
Activate the One Ring creature by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the One Ring creature.
Repeat from step 5.
1742-1978-3363-7714.notes: For the first loop, in step 6, you can either discard an additional card for {B} or provide {1}. On subsequent loops, this won't be an issue. Notably, you can also use the card you drew that turn to discard.

116-512-4188.easyPrerequisites: Accomplished Alchemist and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
116-512-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-4188.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Accomplished Alchemist's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2511-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
2511-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
2511-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

2757-5685-7824.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping an Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

413-1116-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-1116-2946-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Sek'Kuar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

1580-3220-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

193-2369-4423-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
193-2369-4423-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Activate Aminatou's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Aminatou's second ability by removing a loyalty counter on it, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.
193-2369-4423-5733.notes: Mystic Sanctuary can be tapped for mana before casting Notorious Throng if it's able to do so.

4559-5231-5805-7306.easyPrerequisites: Two or more opponents have lost life this turn.
4559-5231-5805-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
4559-5231-5805-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gev.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7154.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2034-5078-6089-7028.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Diving Top and then discard any card that isn't Sensei's Divining Top.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5657-5664-5904.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Writhing Chrysalis and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, activate Adric's first ability by paying {2}{U} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Writhing Chrysalis's trigger, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of at least two Writhing Chrysalis spells, at least two Writhing Chrysalis's triggers, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve a Writhing Chrysalis trigger, creating two Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from 5 any number of times.
Once you have infinite copies of the spells and triggers, you can resolve them all, activate any number of Eldrazi Spawn tokens, and trigger all Writhing Chrysalis's final abilities.
5657-5664-5904.notes: You may also perform this combo with {C}{C} less starting mana, skipping step 5. This does not result in infinite colorless mana or infinite creature tokens.

104-671-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-671-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-5231-6968.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2232-2792-5686-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-2792-5686-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Great Whale.
Repeat.

339-677-5295-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

585-1308-4508-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1445-2366-6413-6753.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-6413-6753.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-6618.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-6618.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Relm's Sketching
141-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Relm's Sketching, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

2054-2440-2905-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite
2054-2440-2905-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Pestermite with haste.
When the token Pestermite enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Pestermite trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Pestermite, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Pestermite for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Urn of Godfire twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

3668-3719-4893-5326.manaNeeded: {U}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
3668-3719-4893-5326.notablePrerequisites: Flesh Duplicate has a power of at least 2.
3668-3719-4893-5326.description:
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} plus command tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Flesh Duplicate and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Flesh Duplicate from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Flesh Duplicate to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Flesh Duplicate enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Flesh Duplicate by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

4275-5231-5470.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
4275-5231-5470.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Repeat from step 2.

1069-1256-2837-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-2837-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Cat.
Activate the Cat by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1247-2092-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 1 or greater.
1247-2092-4289.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {1} due to Agatha of the Vile Cauldron and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it for Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

215-1322-3172.notablePrerequisites: Forests and green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{G}.
215-1322-3172.description:
Activate all Forests and all mana-producing green creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Patron of the Orochi by tapping it, untapping all Forests and all green creatures.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Patron of the Orochi to your hand.
Cast Patron of the Orochi by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If Forests and/or green creatures you control can tap to produce at least {8}{G}{G}{G}, this combo nets infinite mana.

2060-2913-4017-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Boulderbranch Golem.
Boulderbranch Golem enters the battlefield, causing you to gain six life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting six +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

751-1425-2757.description:
Activate a basic Island you control by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Primordial Sage triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Shrieking Drake, untapping a tapped basic Island.
Resolve Shrieking Drake's trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
